issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class Lecture: the template repository defines a constructor with three parameters: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents) while the problem statement and the solution expect a constructor that initializes all five attributes in this order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). This discrepancy between the template signature and the UML/problem description will confuse students about the required constructor signature and parameter order and may cause integration/test failures when students follow the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor declaration in the template Lecture.java to match the UML and solution signature and parameter order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). You may leave the body as a TODO for students to implement or provide the field assignments as in the solution. Ensure the parameter order exactly matches the problem statement to avoid student confusion.
